title: Memo Re Chu-Liu-Wu

page_data.en:
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.1. D. REGISTER
No. I. O. D. 1173.
April 14th 1930. f...4.- 30.

Very little is known locally of the antecedents of
Mr. Chu Liu-wu (朱綏任), newly appointed Acting
Minister of Justice, beyond the facts that he is not a
lawyer and was formerly employed with the Ministry of
Justice at Peking where, during the Yuan Shih-kai regime,
he was on friendly terms with Dr. Wong Chung-hui, now
President of the Judicial Yuan, through whose influence
he secured his new post. Mr. Chu's reputation is said
to be very good.

(same as above) ||

Ian Macleay
Clerical Asst.

A/D.C.I.

a/D.C.I.
Information.
M.G.
16/4/30.

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号 1. D. 登记簿
编号 I. O. D. 1173。
1930年4月14日。f...4.- 30。

当地对新任代理司法部长朱綏任先生（Mr. Chu Liu-wu）的过往经历知之甚少，仅知他并非律师出身，此前曾供职于北京司法部。在袁世凯执政时期，他与现任司法院院长王宠惠博士（Dr. Wong Chung-hui）交好，并凭借王的影响获得了这一新职。据说朱先生的声誉甚佳。

（同上）||

伊恩·麦克利（Ian Macleay）
文书助理

副刑事侦缉处长助理

REUTER'S PACIFIC SERVICE RPS: 7.

NANKING, APRIL 11.

IMPORTANT CHANGES WERE MADE IN THE PERSONNEL OF
THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT AT A MEETING OF THE STATE
COUNCIL THIS MORNING AND TWO MANCHURIAN NOMINEES
WERE GIVEN POSTS.

MR. LIU CHI-WEN, THE MAYOR OF NANKING, WAS APPOINTED
DIRECTOR OF SHANGHAI CUSTOMS.

THE MINISTER OF JUSTICE, DR. WEI TAO-MING, WAS
APPOINTED MAYOR OF NANKING.

THE FORMER VICE-MINISTER OF JUSTICE, MR. CHU LIU-
WU, WAS APPOINTED ACTING-MINISTER OF JUSTICE.

MR. WANG CHIA-CHEN, A MANCHURIAN NOMINEE, WAS
APPOINTED VICE-MINISTER FOR FOREIGN AFFAIRS.

MR. CHANG AO-HUA, THE FORMER VICE-MINISTER FOR
FOREIGN AFFAIRS, WAS APPOINTED VICE-MINISTER OF THE
INTERIOR.

THE FORMER ACTING-MINISTER OF HEALTH, DR. J.H.
LIU, WAS APPOINTED MINISTER OF HEALTH.

MR. HU JAO-JUI, THE FORMER DIRECTOR OF THE PEIPING
OCTROI, ANOTHER MANCHURIAN NOMINEE, WAS APPOINTED
VICE-MINISTER OF HEALTH. -- REUTER'S PACIFIC SERVICE.

11.4.30
MJC/LI.

路透社太平洋分社 RPS: 7。

南京，4月11日。

今晨国务会议对国民政府人事进行了重要调整，两名东北籍提名人选获得任命。

南京市市长刘志文先生被任命为江海关税务司。

司法部长魏道明博士被任命为南京市市长。

前司法部次长朱綏任先生被任命为代理司法部长。

东北籍提名人选王家桢先生被任命为外交部次长。

前外交部次长张敖华先生被任命为内政部次长。

前代理卫生部长刘瑞恒博士（Dr. J.H. Liu）被任命为卫生部长。

前北平统税局局长、另一名东北籍提名人选胡耀儒先生被任命为卫生部次长。——路透社太平洋分社。

1930年4月11日
MJC/LI。
